components.name: Primary Button

components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 0.7rem 1.25rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #161A22; background: #161A22; color: #F4F4F1; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3B424E; border-color: #3B424E; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(53, 97, 138, 0.45), 0 0 0 1.5px #161A22; }

components.name: Default Button

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Mono uppercase instrument link with growing underline on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Fragment Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: #3B424E; padding-block: 0.5rem; position: relative; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 100%; bottom: 0.3rem; height: 1px; background: #35618A; transition: right 320ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #161A22; } .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #161A22; } .ds-nav-link.is-active::after { right: 0; }

narrative.overview: A research laboratory bench where a serious study is laid out for inspection: premium data product meets editorial storytelling. The page reads like a well-kept lab notebook plus a rigorous data readout: serif-display headlines carry the argument, mono uppercase labels act as instrument markings, and a faint gridpaper underpins the hero. Density is editorial but disciplined; the atmosphere is calm, evidence-first, and explicitly neutral — the site's whole stance is "we don't know which model will win," and the visuals never oversell. Color is semantic only: each model family and each outcome type has one restrained hue; nothing is decorative. One deliberate inversion: the Uncertainty section becomes The Dark Lab — the only dark surface on the page.
keyCharacteristics: Cool stone paper and near-white surfaces, never cream or warm paper.
Serif argument headlines over sans body with mono instrument labels.
Color is semantic only — each model family and outcome type has one restrained hue.
Flat-by-default depth: hairline borders, small precise radii (4/8/14px), low offset-blur shadows.
One deliberate inversion: the Uncertainty section becomes The Dark Lab.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Color marks meaning: model family, inventory outcome, uncertainty. No decoration, no gradients, no gratuitous accents. If a color can't be named, it doesn't get used.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Every measurement or meta annotation is mono, uppercase, tracked. If it reads like an instrument marking, it is mono.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest flat; elevation is a 1px hairline plus a whisper of shadow, only where structure demands it.

dos: Do label every measurement, stamp, and nav item in tracked uppercase mono.
Do keep color semantic — steel blue for traditional, violet for LLM, green for inventory outcomes.
Do cap prose at 66ch and let sections breathe with the full --section-pad rhythm.
Do use the Dark Lab inversion for uncertainty content as the page's single dramatic moment.
donts: Don't decorate with color — no gradients, no colorful fills; washes stay at ≈8–12% tint.
Don't add hard block shadows or floating cards without hairlines.
Don't break the ladder's axis metaphor (tick + name + category per rung) into a generic grid.
Don't show invented results, meter fill, or 'winner' states — pending is a real state on this site.
